name: budget-notebook-warm
scene: Open notebook and pen in warm light
prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: original opaque full-screen household-budget background for the pixel-art game Next, Please!, native viewport 570 x 320.
Generate a completely new illustration. Landscape 16:9, ideally 1710 x 960.
Style: understated, carefully clustered low-resolution pixel art matching a worn 1983 analog clinic and modest domestic interiors. Hard square pixel edges, sparse restrained dithering, charcoal-olive shadows, muted warm wood and yellowed cream paper. Not photorealistic, not glossy, not smooth digital painting.
Composition: an intimate overhead still life on a continuous dark old wooden tabletop, filling the entire frame. The LEFT 63 PERCENT of the image must contain ONLY very dark low-contrast wood texture, no objects or bright lines: localized household budget text will occupy this space. All illustrated subjects lie entirely inside the RIGHT 35 PERCENT, leaving a dark breathing margin. A coherent naturally lit tabletop, no split panels, no UI, no painted overlay. The objects must be large enough to recognize at 570 x 320, not tiny decorations.
Subjects: exactly ONE plain everyday exercise notebook and ONE inexpensive period ballpoint PEN, with an ink nib and simple cap, no pencil. No other stationery. Scene variant A: a worn open olive-cloth exercise notebook, slightly turned clockwise, in the upper-right to middle-right of the tabletop. A single dark blue ballpoint pen rests diagonally on the right-hand page. Quiet amber light enters from beyond the upper-right edge; its source is not visible. No money. The open notebook is the only main visual focus.
Constraints: no people, hands, lamps, furniture silhouettes, chairs, radio, mug, food, plants, wallets, receipts, envelopes, calculator or decoration. No readable writing, letters, numbers, currency symbols, logos, watermarks, borders, map or identifiable country. Notebook may have very faint ruled lines and a few tiny illegible ink strokes only. Keep lighting subdued, left region nearly black olive, and paper warm cream rather than white. Original artwork.
MANDATORY LAYOUT: The open notebook's entire spread spans ONLY 26 percent of the image width. Its LEFTMOST edge is at 70 percent of the image width (native x399), its rightmost edge at 96 percent (native x547). Center all objects around (83% width, 52% height). Show generous empty tabletop on every side. This is a wide shot of mostly bare tabletop, NOT a close crop of an oversized notebook. All objects, shadows and highlights must stay to the right of the 65-percent boundary. The entire left 65% is almost black with extremely faint wood texture.
